description: This file defines a React functional component called VideoMeta that displays video metadata such as title, channel name, views, published date, description, and interactive buttons for like, dislike, save, and share. It manages internal state for user interactions and formats view count and date labels.

methods.name: toggleLike
methods.description: Toggles the liked state and resets disliked if liked is set to true.

methods.name: toggleDislike
methods.description: Toggles the disliked state and resets liked if disliked is set to true.
